text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I stroll around the academy, I spot
Seeking the
Pearl completely absorbed
in a dance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Th-that's it! My heart... is rac—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know... I shouldn't. I'm still tired from
my race,
but...
choice_data_list: だ、大丈夫？無理しないほうが……

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm the precious pearl who reveals
possibilities to
the world! It's my duty to
stir people's hearts
through my dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need to up the beat even more! Go
away,
fatigue and exhaustion! No one
needs you here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is as enthusiastic as
ever, but
she seems worn out from her
races. I'll need to
rethink her upcoming
race schedule.
